limits: Test callbacks record source effect deliveries; test does not claim original GPU/camera/dialogue/save effects executed.
Host supplies original collision geometry and qualified trigger facts.
Multiplayer all-player scripts, trigger effects, door hooks fail explicitly until additional provider exists.
Original script skip/network/debug pipelines are caller admission/command services, not implemented internally.
Whole campaign acceptance remains pending root integration.
callbacks: Explicit source admission, execute, blocking, update and bounded random providers. Runtime contains no map/profile/warrior-specific logic.

source_rules.schedule: One context per global script ID, common-then-level order, captured one sweep per tick. Newly started lower-ID context executes next tick.
source_rules.wait: Execute resets elapsed0 and copies duration. IsBlocking signed elapsed<duration BEFORE Update. Update adds frame delta with32-bit wrap. Completion advances only next scheduler call; no overflow consumption.
source_rules.trigger: Host delivers original inside/condition/alive eligibility. Source-keyed trigger edges, count/delay, StartScript only if not running; counts consumed at correct entry/exit branch.
source_rules.nested_call: Original scalar8 common/global flag; false offsets level ID by common count. Scalar24 blocking waits for child. Random array delegates source RNG; no default RNG.
source_rules.failure: Unsupported command callback fails explicitly and retains reached source state. Invalid negative dt is rejected without making runtime permanently failed.
